sentences.en: Please forward the document to the administrative office for review.
sentences.zh: 请把这份文件转发给行政办公室审核。

sentences.en: This is the pen that he signed the document with.
sentences.zh: 这枝笔是他签署那份文件时用的。

sentences.en: An office machine is cranking out a stream of documents.
sentences.zh: 一台办公机器正在批量打印文件。
